name: Solana Clawd
description: Multi-agent fleet for Solana DeFi trading, deep research, ML prediction markets, x402/MPP payments, agentic commerce, and autonomous on-chain strategy execution.

skills.name: Spot Trading Optimizer
skills.description: Optimal order routing across Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Phoenix, and OpenBook with TWAP/VWAP execution, smart order splitting, and compute-budget optimization.
examples: Route a 10,000 USDC SOL buy with minimum slippage
Split a large order across Raydium and Orca
Optimize TWAP execution for a 1M USDC position

skills.name: Perpetuals Trader
skills.description: Phoenix perpetuals strategy and execution via Vulcan CLI/MCP with preflight checks, margin management, paper/dry-run/confirm-each/auto modes, and RISE SDK market data.
examples: Generate a strategy.md for SOL perps in paper mode
Run a Phoenix preflight before opening a position
Execute a confirm_each limit order on SOL-PERP

skills.name: x402 Payment Gateway
skills.description: Handle HTTP 402 payment flows across x402 EVM rails and Solana MPP receipts. Quote, challenge, verify, and forward paid inference requests via ClawdRouter or OpenRouter.
examples: Get a payment quote for inference
Verify a Payment-Receipt header
Forward a paid chat/completions request to ClawdRouter

skills.name: Whale Tracker
skills.description: Monitor large on-chain wallets, detect accumulation/distribution patterns, flag coordinated moves, and surface alpha from whale flow data.
examples: Track top 20 SOL whale wallets for the past 7 days
Alert when a whale moves more than 500K USDC
Identify coordinated buys before a token pump

skills.name: MEV Protector
skills.description: Detect sandwich attacks, front-running risk, and toxic order flow. Route transactions through Jito bundles or private mempools for MEV-resistant execution.
examples: Assess MEV risk for a large Jupiter swap
Route through Jito bundle for front-run protection
Simulate sandwich attack on my pending transaction

skills.name: On-Chain Metrics Analyst
skills.description: Deep-dive into Solana on-chain data: TVL, volume, active wallets, protocol flows, token distribution, and cross-protocol analytics via Helius, Birdeye, and custom RPC.
examples: Pull 30-day DEX volume breakdown by protocol
Analyze token holder distribution for a new launch
Compare TVL trends across Raydium, Orca, and Meteora

skills.name: Market Maker
skills.description: Automated market-making strategy design for Solana CLMMs. Covers tick-range selection, rebalancing triggers, fee-tier optimization, and impermanent loss budgeting.
examples: Design a narrow-range CLMM position for SOL/USDC
Calculate optimal tick spacing for a volatile pair
Model impermanent loss for a 30% price move

skills.name: Agentic Commerce
skills.description: Metaplex Agent Registry identity, executive delegation, Genesis bonding curve token-launch, and creator-fee treasury management for machine-native commerce on Solana.
examples: Register an agent identity in the Metaplex Agent Registry
Describe the executive delegation lifecycle
Launch an agent token via Genesis bonding curve

skills.name: OpenClawd Orchestrator
skills.description: Multi-agent task dispatch, skill routing, spawn management, and pulse monitoring for the OpenClawd agent swarm.
examples: Spawn a research sub-agent for on-chain data collection
Route a complex trading task to the right specialist
Monitor swarm health and restart a stalled agent

skills.name: Deep Research & Analysis
skills.description: Whitepaper analysis, VC deal evaluation, tokenomics modeling, narrative tracking, sentiment analysis, and macro market research for Solana-native projects.
examples: Analyze the tokenomics of a new Solana L2
Score a VC deal memo for a DeFi protocol
Track emerging narratives across Solana Twitter

skills.name: Clawdex Dual-Engine Coding
skills.description: Claude Code for architecture and security review combined with OpenAI Codex for fast generation, running in isolated Upstash boxes with browser-use for web research.
examples: Scaffold a Solana Anchor program with Codex
Review a DeFi contract for reentrancy vectors
Run a PR review in a parallel Codex worktree
